pr_body:
This change makes MigrationContext public to fix #36544.

* Add docs to MigrationContext and `migrate` method.
* Add `nodoc` to all the private methods for this class.
* Delete filtering behavior from `up`/`down`. This shouldn't be used by
anyone since this was private. It's also an odd feature.
* Delete `run` - all the callers can use `up` or `down` instead of
passing that to `run`.

cc/ @schneems - I finally got around to this 😸
pr_comments: Thanks for this. We've been using `MigrationContext` in the PaperTrail test suite for a while. Prior to 5.2, we used `Migrator`. We use `MigrationContext#migrate`, primarily to test a generator that writes a migration. We test this generator end-to-end, writing the migration to disk and migrating a real db. Not sure if we're doing (any part of) it right, but it's what we do, so (for that dubious reason alone) glad to see it become public.

I need to table and think about this for a bit. I don't want to make the entire MigrationContext class public because I want to get rid of a bunch of methods in it. In my efforts to reduce its surface area this turned into more of a rabbit hole than I expected. 

Part of me wants to make a new class just for public use that makes a new MigrationContext and only exposes `migrate`, that way I can keep `up`, `down`, `run`, etc private. But it feels wrong to make a new class just for that. `Migrator` and `MigrationContext` seem similar enough they shouldn't be separate but untangling those may take a bit. This wasn't going to make it into 6.1 anyway (already released) so we have time to figure this one out. If you use any other methods besides `new` and `migrate` in `MigrationContext` please let me know here.

>> We use MigrationContext#migrate, primarily to test a generator that writes a migration. We test this generator end-to-end, writing the migration to disk and migrating a real db.

> If you use any other methods besides .. migrate .. please let me know ..

We only use `#migrate`, thanks. We test our migration-generator a few times, relying on transaction rollback to clean up our db between tests. Perhaps this desire to use rollback is why we began to use `MigrationContext` programmatically, instead of running `rake db:migrate` in a subshell.

issue_context.title: Need a public method for migrating database in tests
issue_context.body:
For gems that use database migrations, many of them were previously using this code in a `test_helper.rb` file:

```
ActiveRecord::Migrator.migrate File.expand_path("../dummy/db/migrate/", __FILE__)
```

This method was removed and now people are using:

```
 ActiveRecord::MigrationContext.new('spec/dummy/db/migrate').migrate
```

For example https://github.com/influitive/apartment/pull/523/files, however this is also not a public interface and has changed again in 6.1 https://github.com/rails/rails/commit/7cc27d749c3563e6b278ad01d233cb92ea3b7935 which results in more errors

Can we make MigrationContext a public interface or expose some other "blessed" way to explicitly migrate in tests?
comments: The old method was private too right? I was pretty sure we didn't change the API when I added that.

I think you're correct, it's just one of those things people were using from some stack overflow article or tutorial for a long time and no one really stopped to check if it was an official interface or it just happened to work. I honestly don't even know where I got the `ActiveRecord::Migrator.migrate File.expand_path("../dummy/db/migrate/", __FILE__)` snippet from, but I've got it in a few projects. 

Currently I'm fighting with it in https://github.com/schneems/derailed_benchmarks/blob/088a53e181e6f264b96e21c2a4c75487b586d4e4/test/test_helper.rb#L29-L36
Do you want to add a public API or wait for me to do it? It's on my list but lower down compared to some of the public 🐛s I created 😆

I'm hunting to see if there's a public way that currently works right now, so I don't think it will be a huge blocker if I can work around it in the short term.

I'll ping you before I start any work on it so we don't overlap. Also if you want any eyes here or want to remote pair, I can put something on the schedule.

I use `ActiveRecord::Migration.maintain_test_schema!`
It also seems like there is a config option for it `config.active_record.maintain_test_schema` mentioned in https://guides.rubyonrails.org/configuring.html

@thomasdziedzic what does calling that do exactly in the context of a engine/library? I tried calling it in derailed_benchmarks and it seemed to do nothing. I ended up using this incantation cribbed from devise https://github.com/schneems/derailed_benchmarks/blob/663be3db7aa9c10efb520c680b54fb33bc954813/test/test_helper.rb#L33-L41

I think "all" we need to do to resolve this issue is make `ActiveRecord::MigrationContext#migrate` public, add some method docs, and document it in the guides engines section.
